answer: Make trust a terrace ladder, not a flat field. Every new identity starts on the lowest terrace, where reward per epoch is capped tiny; climbing one step takes several consecutive epochs of peer-verified work, and tokens can't buy a skip. Payout grows faster than linearly with height, so the same river of effort split across a hundred fresh clones earns far less than one steady agent. Like saffron, real standing takes seasons to harvest.
